thumbnail-gen-skill version 1.1.0

- Updated description and documentation to emphasize "AI youtube thumbnail generator" for better clarity and SEO.
- Adjusted usage examples and instructions to match updated terminology.

- Initial release of YouTube Thumbnail Generator skill.
- Generate AI-powered YouTube thumbnail images from text descriptions via the Neta talesofai API.
- Supports size options: portrait, landscape, square, tall (default: landscape).
- Supports style options: anime, cinematic, realistic (default: cinematic).
- Instantly returns a direct image URL for the generated thumbnail.
